diagnosis_before_the_plan.climate: r44 map world with height map v2 (output/terrain_v2_climate_check/terrain_v2_result.pkl), raw strict zone agreement 0.352
diagnosis_before_the_plan.where_the_zones_are: 64-94 % of each painted zone's cells lie in tier 1 (0-62 m); tiers 2-4 hold 27-37 % of warm-wet, hot-dry, tree and med cells

diagnosis_before_the_plan.conclusion: the terrain lever is small: within-band placement can add at most ~2 points and realistically ~0.5; lowland hills placed where the target wants cooler ground could add more, but hills are Earth-fitted in amount, so only their placement may move

levers.L1_band_position: the tier ramp inside every upland tier becomes lo + (hi - lo) s^gamma_k (k = 2, 3, 4; s is today's 0-1 ramp); every cell stays inside its own band by construction; gamma_k in (0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.25, 1.6)
levers.L2_hill_placement: the tier-1 hilliness field (log-normal at 80 km, terrain_erosion.hills) is mixed with a preference field and rank-matched back to its own distribution, so the amount of hills (the Earth lowland-slope fit) is unchanged and only where they stand moves; preference = +1 where raising a tier-1 climate cell 300 m turns a wrong painted cell right, -1 where it turns a right one wrong (lapse-only, on the v2.1 climate run), smoothed at 80 km; weight w in (0, 0.5, 1.0)
levers.unchanged: erosion detail, the drawn rivers and their Earth-fitted valleys (plan_R1), tier tops, every world parameter

screening: lapse-only emulator on the height map v2.1 climate run (block-mean elevation change x the model's lapse rate, indices and strict zones recomputed): all 125 L1 combinations; the best L1 and each w of L2 are carried to full runs
confirmation: full climate runs (3 seeds, downsample 8, r44 physics) of: best L1 alone; best w of L2 alone (if the emulator gains >= 0.3 points); both together. Score: strict zone agreement raw and with the r44 Earth corrections, total and in the west and east halves of the map (split at the map's centre column)

adoption.gain: corrected strict agreement >= +0.5 points against height map v2.1
adoption.no_half_worse: neither half loses more than 0.3 points (corrected)
adoption.tiers: tier band shares of tiers 2-4 not below v2.1 - 0.02; tier tops unchanged
adoption.earth_realism: tier-1 9 km slope median within 10 % of Earth lowlands (0.167 deg); slope KS against Earth lowlands not worse than v2.1 + 0.02
adoption.otherwise: height map v2.1 stays; the result is reported

honesty: the owner's painted zones are the only target (as in the world refits); there is no Earth test of where hills should stand, so L2 is a fit to the owner's map, labelled as such in the atlas
